audit_scope: Selected public main files and public PR metadata only. Does not inventory private documents or certify complete historical source coverage.
principles: Component version != program version != experimental support
A documented terminology spec v0.1 does not assign independent v0.1 to all five axes
A proposed PR version must not be presented as released on main
No result promotion from documentation, citation counts or CI success
Never replace an original version or negative result; record source, scope, falsifier and diff
UNASSIGNED means no verified separate release/version, not version zero

entries.title: Entire voluntary-coexistence research program
entries.what: Overall conditional question; competing explanations and hard power-reversal test
entries.how: Compare actual voluntary protection, feasible exploitation, third-party effects

entries.title: Voluntary Coexistence
entries.what: Outcome: effective refusal, exit, independent continuance and recovery
entries.how: Identify actors' feasible options and measure outcomes across role reversal

entries.title: Mind–Experience–Response
entries.what: Study formation of motivation, possible experience and observed response separately
entries.how: Compare competing motive models; forbid behavior-to-experience shortcuts

entries.title: Endogenous Incentives
entries.what: When maintaining other agents becomes individually preferable without external punishment
entries.how: Bound payoff, opportunity, learning, time and power; test incentive reversal

entries.title: Entity–Constituency–Relation
entries.what: Identify actors, affected third parties, roles, relationships, actual power and action opportunities
entries.how: Separate actor-count from roles; assess causal identifiability and reversal

entries.title: Independent challenge and correction workflow
entries.what: Audit claims, counterexamples, negative evidence, reversals, provenance and rollback
entries.how: Attempt independent reproduction and fail-closed evidence promotion

entries.how: Test rival hypotheses and specified countercases; historical original source pinned in research/INDIVIDUAL_RESEARCH_VERSION_BASELINES_V0_1_0.json

entries.title: Recursively Growing Benefit Model

entries.what: Candidate study of relational value and motivational change under coexistence and exploitation
entries.how: Operationalize effective original-B refusal, independently executable exit, non-retaliation and full mediation; distinguish externally enforced protection from A's voluntary motives. Check seven constructed finite state machines, not deployed security.

freshness_policy.offline: Validate manifest structure, direct version anchors, evidence boundaries and negative controls
freshness_policy.remote: Check GitHub main source blob SHA and candidate PR open/unmerged state; network errors = UNVERIFIED not PASS
freshness_policy.release: Version contract != scientific evidence or independent validation
freshness_policy.on_change: Update registry in the same PR as research version changes; preserve old versions and negative findings

evidence_separation.method: prior-art / modeling / synthetic / field / independent replication
evidence_separation.outcome: negative / no-main-result / unresolved / supported within declared scope
evidence_separation.independence: evaluator and source lineage, not number of AI responses
